# MCP n24q02m

> A curated suite of nine MCP servers on one foundation library — one transport, one setup command, and one multi-user auth model — so you run web search, memory, Notion, email, Telegram, code review, image generation, Google Workspace, and Godot without wiring up nine inconsistent servers.

Each server ships as a Claude Code plugin, an npm or PyPI package, and a Docker image. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Windsurf. Self-host once and share with a team. Every active server reuses `hull` for its HTTP transport, token auth (no-auth, token, multi), encrypted per-namespace credential storage, and CLI built-ins — no bespoke auth code per server.

## Servers

- [hull (foundation)](https://github.com/n24q02m/hull): Shared core used by every active server — HTTP MCP transport, token auth, encrypted credential storage, CLI built-ins. PyPI `n24q02m-hull`, npm `@n24q02m/hull`.
- [wet](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/wet/setup/): Web search, content extraction, documentation indexing, and X/Twitter search.
- [mnemo](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/mnemo/setup/): Persistent AI memory with hybrid search.
- [crg](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/crg/setup/): Knowledge graph for token-efficient code reviews.
- imagine-mcp (archived, no docs page): Image and video understanding and generation across providers.
- [telegram](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/telegram/setup/): Telegram (Bot API + MTProto) for AI agents.
- [notion](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/notion/setup/): Markdown-first Notion API server.
- [email](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/email/setup/): Email (IMAP + SMTP) composite tools.
- better-godot-mcp (archived, no docs page): Godot Engine integration for AI agents.
- [workspace](https://docs.n24q02m.com/servers/workspace/setup/): Google Workspace — Docs, Drive, Calendar, Gmail, Sheets, Slides, Tasks, Chat, People, and Forms, across multiple accounts.

## Get started

- [Install in Claude Code](https://docs.n24q02m.com/get-started/install-claude-code/): One command to install any server.
- [Plugin marketplace](https://docs.n24q02m.com/get-started/plugin-marketplace/): Browse and install any server as a Claude Code plugin.
- [Modes overview](https://docs.n24q02m.com/get-started/modes-overview/): stdio or self-hosted HTTP, and the HTTP auth modes (no-auth, token, multi) — when to use each.
- [Multi-user setup](https://docs.n24q02m.com/get-started/multi-user/): Per-user credential storage scoped by bearer token and namespace.

## Reference

- [Server comparison](https://docs.n24q02m.com/reference/server-comparison/): Side-by-side comparison of every server.
- [Tool-layout standard](https://docs.n24q02m.com/reference/tool-layout-standard/): The N+2 multiplexed-tool convention every server follows.
